 Practice test

 You are a nursefor the Royal District Nursing Service (RDNS). Your patient,Mrs
 Brown, a 67 year-oldretired school teacher,has Alzheimer's Disease.


 Name:           Mrs Jane Brown

 D.O.B:      '   14102/40

 Sex:            Female

 Occupation: SchoolTeacher(retired)


 Diagnosis

 Alzheimer'sDisease.Symptomsbegan3-4 yearsago.

 Progress

  Memory lossbecomingmore severe. Unableto rememberbasic informationor
  routines.
  Generalmentalcondition deteriorating.
  Verbally aggressive.Sometimesphysically.
  Incontinentof urine.
  Wakesoften during night.
, Difficult to assessdue to hyperactivity.

Family/SocialSituation

 Married.
lives with husband(retired police officer).
 Husbandstrugglingto cope. Often tearfuUfrustrated  at deteriorationin wife's
 condition.-Fearsfor her safety. Feelsimpact on their social life. Reportsbeing very
 tired.
 2 adult sonslive interstate.
 No other family nearby.
 Active in church until recently.

Medical History

CVA 4 yearsago. Right-sided weakness.
